PROJECT NAME: Riverside Library Renovation
Owner: City of Riverside
General Contractor: Northstar Construction LLC
Change Order No.: CO-017
Date Issued: April 4, 2025
Subject: Replace concealed damaged conduit
Description of Change: Remove and replace 80 feet of damaged conduit in the east wing.
Work includes new conduit, fittings, supports, and inspection.
Reason for Change: Existing conduit was corroded and not shown in the contract documents.
Net Change: $12,450.50
Original Contract Sum: $1,200,000.00
Revised Contract Sum: $1,212,450.50
Schedule Impact: 3 calendar days
